review.scopeLimit: Feed and Official file download/share for PNG and MP4. Exhaustive codec/transport matrices, prolonged background playback, other media producers and receiver-specific behavior remain separate.

notes: Feed and Official add distinct Download and Share file actions to the common fullscreen chrome without changing the existing post-link share action.
The common UI keeps busy, failure and Retry state bound to the exact same descriptor and preserves the selected detail after success, cancellation and failure.
Android materializes privately, writes Download through MediaStore and waits for the real chooser selection callback; dismissal is cancellation.
Web fetches at most 50 MiB without credentials or redirects, performs an anchor download or one-file Web Share and revokes every Blob URL.
iOS keeps a protected temporary file alive until UIActivityViewController completes or cancels, then deletes it.
Chat consumes the extracted materialization contract while retaining its prior profile-isolated cache, historical MIME compatibility and Web URL-share fallback.
The evidence uses hermetic media transports and creates no backend mutation. External receiver behavior and unrelated production network failures are not attributed.
Product SHA b4fcf8bc is the single frozen implementation commit; affected validations ran against its exact tree or byte-identical platform sources before attestation-only files were added.
